data.title: Milk Thistle
data.bio: Milk thistle is an apothecary and community space that recently reopened in Joshuatree and previously existed for 2 1/2 years in Yucca Valley. We offer workshops and have a tiny gallery. We like to share accessible information about herbs.
data.showDescription: This is an occasional podcast to talk about astrology and herbalism, not much music!
